        x = self.body(x)
        x = self.neck(x)
        x = self.proj(x)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Encoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.expand = nn.Conv2d(3, 32, 3, padding=1)
        self.tail = nn.Conv2d(32, 12, 5, padding=2)
        self.shrink = nn.BatchNorm2d(12)
        self.head = nn.Conv2d(12, 32, 3, padding=1)
        self.neck = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.post = nn.Flatten()
        self.merge = nn.Linear(32, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.expand(x)
        h2 = F.sigmoid(h1)
        h3 = self.tail(h2)
        h4 = self.shrink(h3)
        h5 = F.sigmoid(h4)
        h6 = self.head(h5)
        h7 = F.sigmoid(h6)
        h8 = self.neck(h7)
        h9 = self.post(h8)
        h10 = self.merge(h9)
        return h10

import torch.nn.functional as func


class Head(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.post = nn.Conv2d(3, 48, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(48, 12, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.mix = nn.Conv2d(12, 16, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.body = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.tail = nn.Flatten()
        self.head = nn.Linear(16, 2, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.post(x)
        x = func.sigmoid(x)
        x = self.proj(x)
        x = func.sigmoid(x)
        x = self.mix(x)
        x = func.sigmoid(x)
        x = self.body(x)
        x = self.tail(x)
        x = self.head(x)
        return x

        x = self.layer4(x)
        x = fn.tanh(x)
        x = self.layer5(x)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as fn


class FeatureNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(FeatureNet, self).__init__()
        self.post = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.shrink = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Linear(16, 16) for _ in range(4)]
        )
        self.merge = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.post(x)
        h2 = fn.silu(h1)
        for layer in self.shrink:
            h2 = layer(h2)
        h3 = fn.silu(h2)
        h4 = self.merge(h3)
        return h4

        super(BlockNet, self).__init__()

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Classifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(Classifier, self).__init__()
        self.expand = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.wide = False
        self.post = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.encode = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(16, 8)
        self.merge = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.neck = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.shrink = nn.Linear(16, 16)
        self.pre = nn.Linear(16, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.expand(x)
        x = torch.sigmoid(x)
        if self.wide:
            x = self.post(x)
        u = self.encode(x)
        right = self.proj(x)

from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as func


class BlockNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.merge = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.mix = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.tail = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.gate = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.neck = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.extra_head = False
        self.post = nn.Linear(32, 32)
        self.head = nn.Linear(32, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.merge(x)
        x = func.relu(x)
        q = self.mix(x)
        u = self.tail(x)
        left = self.gate(x)
        x = q + u
        x = x + left
        x = self.neck(x)
        x = func.relu(x)
        x = self.neck(x)
        if self.extra_head:
            x = self.post(x)
        x = self.head(x)
        return x

class Head(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        """Head built for the graph task."""
        super().__init__()
        self.conv_1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.down_1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.conv_2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 32, 3, padding=1)
        self.up_1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2)
        self.conv_3 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv_4 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.pool_1 = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flat_1 = nn.Flatten()
        self.fc_1 = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # down path
        h1 = self.conv_1(x)
        h2 = func.relu(h1)
        h3 = self.down_1(h2)
        h4 = self.conv_2(h3)
        h5 = func.relu(h4)

        h7 = self.conv_3(h6)

        h9 = self.conv_4(h8)
        h10 = func.relu(h9)
        h11 = self.pool_1(h10)
        h12 = self.flat_1(h11)
        h13 = self.fc_1(h12)
        return h13

        h = torch.relu(h)
        h = self.encode(h)
        h = self.neck(h)
        h = torch.relu(h)
        h = self.mix(h)
        h = h + h
        h = torch.relu(h)
        h = self.body(h)
        h = torch.relu(h)

        h = h + h
        h = torch.relu(h)
        h = self.stem(h)
        h = self.pre(h)

        self.gate = nn.Conv2d(32, 32, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix = nn.BatchNorm2d(32)
        self.pre = nn.Conv2d(32, 32, 3, padding=1)
        self.merge = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.head = nn.Flatten()
        self.encode = nn.Linear(32, 10)

        h2 = func.gelu(h1)
        h3 = self.post(h2)
        h4 = func.gelu(h3)
        h5 = self.body(h4)

        h13 = func.gelu(h12)

class Head(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        """Head built for the graph task."""
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 8, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(8, 8, 1, padding=0)
        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(8, 8, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv4 = nn.Conv2d(8, 8, 5, padding=2)
        self.pool1 = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flat1 = nn.Flatten()
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(24, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        h1 = self.conv1(x)
        h2 = F.gelu(h1)
        # three parallel branches
        a = self.conv2(h2)
        p = self.conv3(h2)
        u = self.conv4(h2)
        h3 = torch.cat([a, p, u], dim=1)
        h4 = F.gelu(h3)
        h5 = self.pool1(h4)
        h6 = self.flat1(h5)
        h7 = self.fc1(h6)
        return h7

        super().__init__()
        self.shrink = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.merge = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.pre = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.post = nn.BatchNorm2d(16)
        self.encode = nn.Conv2d(16, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.body = nn.Flatten()
        self.decode = nn.Linear(16, 2)

        h1 = self.shrink(x)
        h2 = F.gelu(h1)
        # residual block

        h4 = F.gelu(h3)
        h5 = self.stem(h4)
        h6 = h5 + h2
        h7 = F.gelu(h6)

        h9 = self.post(h8)
        h10 = F.gelu(h9)
        h11 = self.encode(h10)
        h12 = h11 + h7
        h13 = F.gelu(h12)
        h14 = self.mix(h13)
        h15 = self.body(h14)
        h16 = self.decode(h15)
        return h16

import torch.nn as nn

class TinyModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        """TinyModel built for the graph task."""
        super(TinyModel, self).__init__()
        self.conv_1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.down_1 = nn.MaxPool2d(2)
        self.conv_2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 32, 3, padding=1)
        self.up_1 = nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2)
        self.conv_3 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv_4 = nn.Conv2d(32, 16, 3, padding=1)
        self.pool_1 = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.flat_1 = nn.Flatten()
        self.fc_1 = nn.Linear(16, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # down path
        x = self.conv_1(x)
        x = torch.sigmoid(x)
        x = self.down_1(x)
        x = self.conv_2(x)
        x = torch.sigmoid(x)
        # up path, with the skip concatenated back in
        x = self.up_1(x)
        x = self.conv_3(x)
        x = torch.cat([x, x], dim=1)
        x = self.conv_4(x)
        x = torch.sigmoid(x)
        x = self.pool_1(x)
        x = self.flat_1(x)
        x = self.fc_1(x)
        return x
